defaults.materialTexturePolicy: Keep normal/ORM/emissive compressed and shared by URL when possible; duplicate only when an asset needs independent quality.

compressionRoadmap: Phase 1 keeps raw float32 geometry for byte-identical rendering while splitting the 100MB supplemental pack into cacheable per-asset files.
Phase 2 encodes geometry.raw.bin as geometry.meshopt.bin with bounds/material metadata unchanged.
Phase 3 moves repeated base-color/normal/ORM/emissive images into family atlases and converts ordinary furniture to 512px WebP/AVIF, hero decals/puzzle art to 1024px.

fallback.policy: Use this bundle first; if it is absent or invalid, fall back to legacy Raw source plans.
